_comment: ADR-037 register fragment, change meeting-attendance-per-meeting (REQ-MAPM-001, matrix row pla-09). MeetingAttendance (slug meeting-attendance: attendance is too generic a slug for the fleet, gate-106) records one participant's attendance at one meeting, so a later meeting no longer overwrites an earlier one. The meeting Participants widget writes it; the meetings report, the quorum check and the meeting cost read it. Participant.attendanceStatus stays as the fallback for meetings that have no attendance records.

MeetingAttendance.title: Attendance
MeetingAttendance.description: Whether one participant attended one meeting.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: The meeting this attendance is for.

participant.title: Participant
participant.description: The participant whose attendance this is.

status.description: Present, absent, sent apologies (excused) or represented by a proxy.
